# SHOPLANCER

> SHOPLANCER is a multi-vendor e-commerce platform that lets local merchants in the MENA region — supermarkets, pharmacies, fashion shops, restaurants, cafés and more — launch a professional online storefront in minutes with no code.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, pricing, FAQ and how-it-works.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Browse every active vendor on SHOPLANCER, filter by category and city.
- [Become a vendor](/vendor/apply): Step-by-step wizard to register a new store and pick a plan.
- [Blog](/blog): Practical guides for local merchants — launching, growing and running a profitable online store.
